description: Create an audio crossword puzzle URL. Unlike the classic crossword, clues are not text hints: each word itself is played back as audio, so the player hears the word and must spell it. You must provide only the list of words (no hints). The list must have between 3 and 30 words. If user specifies count/topic, generate appropriate words first, then call this tool with the words parameter.

language.description: Optional: Language for the crossword. Use the same language as the prompt. Please use ISO 639-1 codes: en, es, fr, de, pt.

topic.description: Optional: Topic/theme for the crossword. Only for reference.

word_count.description: Optional: Number of words requested (3-30). Only for reference/validation.

words.description: Plain list of words (no hints), one per line, separated by newlines. Each word is played back as audio for the player to spell. Must contain 3-30 lines. Each word must be 3-20 letters long. Non-alphabetic characters are allowed but do not count towards length. Words do not need to be uppercased.

name: create_audio_crossword
